title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator takes AI notes of in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, room licensing, default availability and governance controls are supported. Minor clarifications should distinguish scheduled-meeting licensing from the room's consumption-only experience and acknowledge that the Teams Rooms release notes now document the Android feature.

claims.claim: Facilitator can take AI notes of in-person meetings on Teams Rooms on Windows without a scheduled or hybrid meeting.
claims.quote: This enhancement allows teams meeting in a physical room to capture real-time notes, decisions, and action items—without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.
